fields.title: Polka: the feature that eats margin
fields.summary: Sales asks for "live price". Persistent connections cost 180 thousand per month.
fields.decisionPrompt: What do we do? State the cost of your decision.
fields.brief/role: You are the Polka product manager.
fields.brief/company: Polka is a fictional grocery delivery service from local stores: 900 partner stores, a buyer app, and a partner portal.
fields.brief/context: You are the Polka product manager. Proposed feature "live price": the price in the product card updates in real time when changed by the partner. Initiative from sales: three chains requested it, argument is trust in price.
fields.brief/objective: Resolve price distrust without increasing active user cost by 13%.
fields.brief/constraints: Six weeks of development. Webhooks require work on the partner side.
fields.brief/task: Decide what to do and calculate the cost of the solution.
fields.learnTakeaway/title: Real-time costs money, but you need a window
fields.learnTakeaway/body: The request for "real time" almost always means "we find out too late." The price difference between these formulations is persistent connections and growing cost per user. Calculate how much data actually changes, and choose a window: reducing export frequency resolves most distrust within a week and without a new line item on the invoice.
fields.evidenceCards/0/content: Prices update on catalog export once an hour. Cache is 60 seconds.
fields.evidenceCards/1/content: Subscription to partner changes via webhooks plus persistent connection with the app for instant updates of the open card.
fields.evidenceCards/2/content: "Persistent connections: about 40k simultaneous at peak. Cost — roughly 180k/month extra. Partner webhooks — free, but require partner-side work. Development — 6 weeks."
fields.evidenceCards/3/content: Cost per active user 7.5 RUB/month, total 1.35M/month. Gross margin 64%.
fields.decisionOptions/0/consequence: solves the problem for 40 partners ready for webhooks. Cost per active user grows from 7.5 to 8.5 RUB, a 13% increase. For 860 partners, nothing changes — their prices still update once an hour.
fields.decisionOptions/1/label: Shorten window: export every 10 minutes instead of an hour for 40 large partners
fields.decisionOptions/1/description: Shorten window: export every 10 minutes instead of an hour for 40 large partners. 1 week, cost remains almost unchanged.
fields.decisionOptions/1/consequence: staleness window drops from an hour to 10 minutes. Not "real time", but 96% of items do not change price during the day at all. Support tickets should nearly disappear.
fields.decisionOptions/2/label: Check price upon adding to cart and show change
fields.decisionOptions/2/description: Check price upon adding to cart and show change. 2 weeks.
fields.decisionOptions/2/consequence: attacks not price staleness, but its consequence — discrepancy at checkout. Cost is minimal. Does not solve trust in the product card.
fields.decisionOptions/3/consequence: 60 tickets out of 14 thousand — 0.4%. Saves 6 weeks and 180k/month. Requires explaining to sales and three chains.
fields.rubric/remediation/0/gap: Does not calculate unit cost of the solution
fields.rubric/remediation/1/gap: Does not check problem scale with estimation
fields.rubric/remediation/2/gap: Does not connect infrastructure to margin
fields.rubric/remediation/3/gap: Request and user cost not calculated before decision
fields.rubric/remediation/4/gap: Does not question whether to optimize this at all
